## Summary

Implemented the welcome-notification side-effect on successful owner creation.

**New function** — `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/NotifyWelcome.java`: a single-method OfficeFloor step that reads the created `Owner` via `@Val` and emits an info line to the logger named `NOTIFY` containing both the owner id and the `memberId`:

```java
NOTIFY.info("Welcome owner id={} memberId={}", owner.getId(), owner.getMemberId());
```

**Pipeline wiring** — `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: inserted a `notifyWelcome` step (with `govern: [ transaction ]`, consistent with the rest of the pipeline) between `audit` and `respond`. It runs only after `save` (so the id is assigned) and `assignMemberId` (so the memberId is set), i.e. only on a successful create.

The new `AcceptanceTest.coreEnqueuesWelcome`, which captures the `NOTIFY` logger and asserts a line contains both the owner id and memberId, passes — as does the full suite (`BUILD SUCCESS`). Observed output confirms it: `INFO NOTIFY - Welcome owner id=11 memberId=NSW2716E6609E1`.
